launch_evidence.quote: VICTRELIS (boceprevir), the company's oral hepatitis C protease inhibitor, was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and in Europe by the European Medicines Agency. The U.S. launch of VICTRELIS is underway.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2011Q3, one quarter after the 2011Q2 launch: no filing prints 2011Q2 as the current quarter. Merck's second-quarter 2011 release (dex991.htm, 2011-07-29) and Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2011 describe the approval and launch but print no VICTRELIS sales figure; the 2011Q2 amount (21) appears only as a historical column in the third-quarter 2011 trend table.
series_end_reason: Merck's first-quarter 2015 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/310158/000110465915030743/a15-9874_1ex99d1.htm) and every later 2015 release carry no VICTRELIS row; the fourth-quarter 2014 release Exhibit 99.2 (a15-3619_1ex99d2.htm) is the last to print one.
search_log: Full-text search of CIK 310158 (Merck & Co.) filings 2011-2018 for 'victrelis'; every 8-K exhibit returned was parsed for a row whose first cell is VICTRELIS; Form 10-Q for 2011Q2 read for a quarter figure (none).
Each quarter read from the quarter's own Exhibit 99.2 Global/U.S./International table.

Checks: 2012 quarters 111+126+149+115 = 501 vs 502 in the year column of the fourth-quarter 2012 Exhibit 99.2 ('VICTRELIS | 502 | 140'), whole-million rounding; 2013 110+116+121+81 = 428 = 'VICTRELIS | 428 | 502'; 2014 59+46+27+21 = 153 = 'VICTRELIS | 153 | 428'.
